_note: Packaged food products with at least 10 customer reviews posted in 2025 on Amazon, Walmart, Target and Kroger product pages, from a commercial collection of retailer reviews. A product counts as food if the collection tags it food. Each bin counts products whose average rating falls in a 0.05-wide band: 1.00 to 1.05, and so on, the last band including 5.00. See methods.html#m-food. Shares compare each product's star total with the threshold times its review count, so there is no rounding.
